item.title: The Stargate Paradox: When Is Humanity Doomed?
item.description: Is extinction inevitable if there is any chance of reproductive failure? Explore branching processes, born from Victorian concerns about aristocratic surnames, to understand when populations face certain doom and when survival remains possible.

item.title: From Pushkin to PageRank: How Generating Functions Solve Markov Chain Problems
item.description: Learn how Markov chains emerged from a 19th-century academic rivalry over Pushkin’s poetry, and discover how generating functions solve complex probability problems, from predicting weather to powering Google’s PageRank algorithm.
